classification.difficultyReason: Combine factor roots, the y-intercept and leading-coefficient sign into rough cubic sketches with correct crossings and end behaviour.

inlines.text: Sketch the graph of the following.

answer.short: $x$-intercepts: $(-3,0)$, $(-1,0)$, $(1,0)$. $y$-intercept: $(0,-3)$. Crosses at each root; left tail down, right tail up.
answer.worked:
The factors give single roots at $x=-3,-1,1$.

At $x=0$,
$$\begin{align*}y&=(-1)(1)(3)\\y&=-3.\end{align*}$$
The coefficient of $x^3$ is positive. Draw a smooth cubic through the intercepts, crossing the $x$-axis at each root, with two turning points, its left tail down and its right tail up.

answer.worked:
The factors give single roots at $x=-1,2,3$.

At $x=0$,
$$\begin{align*}y&=-(1)(-2)(-3)\\y&=-6.\end{align*}$$
The coefficient of $x^3$ is negative. Draw a smooth cubic through the intercepts, crossing the $x$-axis at each root, with two turning points, its left tail up and its right tail down.
